hook: Deloitte Cyprus helped Roman Abramovich hide $10 billion in assets.

sections.voiceover: Deloitte Cyprus helped Roman Abramovich hide $10 billion in assets.
Meritservus falsified 1,000 corporate papers for the billionaire. Staff used fake timestamps to rewrite the historical record. Where did those $672 million in vanished assets go?
Leaked emails reveal retroactive asset transfers to the British Virgin Islands.
Superyachts, mansions, and private jets vanished directly from company accounts. Deloitte Cyprus signed off every single falsified document. Tax obligations dissolved entirely.
Expose the audit firms hiding billionaire fortunes.
